disease.diseaseId: Neurodevelopmental disorder with hypotonia, neuropathy, and deafness
disease.description: An autosomal recessive disorder characterized by congenital myopathy with hypotonia and muscle weakness manifesting after birth and progressing to generalized muscle atrophy, central deafness with absent brainstem-evoked potentials, and a combined axonal and demyelinating motor neuropathy.
